pairs.registryProposal: modal-stack is listed on only one context in this repo (template-gallery-modals, lexical-only). The owned registry itself, src/lib/ui/ModalStackContext.tsx and src/lib/ui/BaseModal.tsx, which the react--stack-ownership application cites as its primary evidence, is not governed by modal-stack in the map at all; the shared UI context owning src/lib/ui should carry this pair. Separately, the react--stack-ownership application calls the feature-private useModalStack a clean composition with the app registry, while the technique refuses a second stack outright; the application should name it a deviation or the technique should admit a feature-scoped typed front-end over the app registry.
